text: @huanlin/dsh-plugin-session-delete 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的会话管理插件，在会话头部和侧栏菜单提供删除入口，并提供供 agent 调用的 workbench_session_delete 工具。用户确认后，它会停止正在运行的 agent，清理会话日志、投影缓存和工作区记账，再刷新会话列表；侧栏入口可在不切换当前对话的情况下定位目标会话。界面提供中英文文案。适合需要从 DSH 清理会话记录的用户；不需要 API key，日志位置使用 DSH_HOME 或默认的 ~/.dsh。

@huanlin/dsh-plugin-session-delete adds DSH web session deletion through a header button, sidebar item and agent tool. After confirmation it stops a running agent, removes its log and storage records, and refreshes the list. Chinese and English UI; no API key required.
想从 DSH 会话页面彻底删除一段对话，而不是只把它藏起来。
能不能在当前对话顶部加一个删除按钮？
我想从侧栏菜单删除旧会话，而且不切换当前对话。
给 agent 一个能按 session id 删除会话的工具。
删除正在运行的会话时，先停止它再清理记录。
删除会话后刷新列表，并从列表里移除相关存储记录。
How can I remove an old DSH session from the conversation UI?
I need an agent tool that deletes a session and clears its stored records.
@huanlin/dsh-plugin-session-delete 的功能「会话头部删除入口」：在当前会话头部操作区添加垃圾桶按钮，点击后打开共享删除确认对话框。
@huanlin/dsh-plugin-session-delete 的功能「侧栏会话删除入口」：在侧栏会话行的“…”菜单注入删除项，通过行标题解析目标会话并打开确认框，不切换当前对话。
@huanlin/dsh-plugin-session-delete 的功能「删除确认对话框」：显示会话名称和 ID；用户勾选确认后才能提交删除，并显示运行状态、处理中状态或错误信息。
@huanlin/dsh-plugin-session-delete 的功能「清理会话数据」：删除会话日志目录、投影缓存行和工作区/归档记账；对 raw UUID 与 session- 前缀形式进行清理。
@huanlin/dsh-plugin-session-delete 的功能「Agent 删除工具」：注册 workbench_session_delete 工具，接收 sessionId 并返回日志、投影缓存和工作区记录的删除结果。

@huanlin/dsh-plugin-session-delete README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add file:C:/path/to/dsh-plugin-session-delete
```

重启 profile 生效。

@huanlin/dsh-plugin-session-delete README · 功能：- 会话头部垃圾桶按钮
- 侧栏会话行 "..." 菜单注入"删除会话"项
- `RiskConfirmation` 风险确认：勾选"我已了解后果"后确认可用
- 删除链路：会话目录 + 投影缓存 + 工作区记账（经活动 storageDomain，内存/磁盘一致）
- `workbench_session_delete` 工具：agent 可直接删除会话

@huanlin/dsh-plugin-session-delete README · dsh-plugin-session-delete：Frustrated that sessions can't be deleted from the web client? Bothered by abandoned or mistyped conversations cluttering your sidebar? Ever tried editing your harness only to find the session history out of sync — with a corrupted session that just won't go away? This plugin has your back!

@huanlin/dsh-plugin-session-delete README · dsh-plugin-session-delete：**Safely delete sessions from the DeepSeek Harness UI.** Adds a trash button at the top of the conversation and a "Delete session" item to the sidebar session-row "..." menu; clicking either opens a risk-consent dialog (checkbox required). On confirm, the session log, projection cache and workspace accounting are removed. Running sessions show a warning — if you still choose to delete, the session is stopped and then deleted. Works in the web, and is theoretically compatible with any web-shell-based client.
**Also adds an agent tool so agents can delete sessions.** Tool name: `workbench_session_delete`

@huanlin/dsh-plugin-session-delete README · Installation：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add file:C:/path/to/dsh-plugin-session-delete
```

Restart the profile to apply.

@huanlin/dsh-plugin-session-delete README · Features：- Trash button at the top of the conversation
- "Delete session" item injected into the sidebar session-row "..." menu
- `RiskConfirmation` risk-consent dialog: confirm is only enabled after ticking "I understand the consequences"
- Delete chain: session log + projection cache + workspace accounting (through the active storageDomain, so in-memory state and on-disk units stay consistent)
- `workbench_session_delete` tool: agents can delete sessions directly
